title: Two questions on $E_0$-like generic equivalence
summary: We answer Problems 8.1 and 8.3 from \cite{Tianyuan2026}. We first note that the condition attributed there to ordinary Prikry forcing is not correct as written: the appropriate formulation uses finite symmetric difference of the ranges of the generic sequences, rather than eventual equality at the same coordinates. We record answers to the two problems for both formulations. A length-$ω$ Magidor forcing gives a genuinely Prikry-type example satisfying both conditions.
